lines.text: Many learners say: I lost the bus this morning.
Better: I missed the bus this morning.
Miss! You will miss the train.

en.hook: Do you say “I lost the bus”?
en.tip: When you “perder” a bus, use “miss”. “Lose” is for objects.
en.caption: Watch out for this common mistake! Many people say “I lost the bus this morning.”. The right way is “I missed the bus this morning.”. Portuguese “perder” covers both cases. Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
